evidence.claim: BBVA is registered as a non-U.S. swap dealer with CFTC and non-US security based swap dealer with SEC
evidence.excerpt: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) is registered as a non-U.S. swap dealer with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and as a non-US security based swap dealer with the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC), with LEI K8MS7FD7N5Z2WQ51AZ71.
evidence.notes: Establishes derivatives market participation and regulatory reporting obligations.

evidence.claim: BBVA Bancomer S.A. adhered to ISDA 2012 FATCA Protocol
evidence.excerpt: BBVA Bancomer S.A. has adhered to the ISDA 2012 FATCA Protocol as published by the International Swaps and Derivatives Association.
evidence.notes: Standard ISDA protocol adherence, not CDM-specific. Historical context only.

evidence.claim: BBVA SEGUROS adhered to ISDA 2018 U.S. Resolution Stay Protocol with ultimate parent Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
evidence.excerpt: BBVA SEGUROS SA DE SEGUROS Y REASEGUROS has adhered to the ISDA 2018 U.S. Resolution Stay Protocol. The ultimate parent is BANCO BILBAO VIZCAYA ARGENTARIA, SOCIEDAD ANONIMA.
evidence.notes: Standard ISDA protocol adherence, not CDM-specific.

evidence.claim: Accenture provided BBVA trading services with Murex/Calypso alliance for integrated global products
evidence.excerpt: Accenture helped BBVA offer customers an integrated, global portfolio of products and services. This was part of Accenture's capital markets trading services, which involves strong alliances with Murex, Calypso and Misys.
evidence.notes: Vendor relationship for trading services, but no specific CDM mention. May use standard Murex/Calypso without CDM modules.
